programs=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-medium-fresh0/frozen/seen-reference-3/play/users/u064/system/state/workspace/programs')

source='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    points = [(r, c, grid[r][c]) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] != 0]
    # The pattern is encoded by constant-color horizontal or down-right diagonal lines.
    orientations = [lambda r, c: r, lambda r, c: c-r]
    chosen = None
    for keyfn in orientations:
        lines = {}
        valid = True
        for r, c, color in points:
            key = keyfn(r, c)
            if key in lines and lines[key] != color:
                valid = False
                break
            lines[key] = color
        if valid:
            chosen = (keyfn, lines)
            break
    keyfn, lines = chosen
    period = next(p for p in range(1, max(h, w)*2+1)
                  if all(lines[a] == lines[b] for a in lines for b in lines if (a-b) % p == 0))
    residues = {k % period: color for k, color in lines.items()}
    return [[residues[keyfn(r, c) % period] for c in range(w)] for r in range(h)]
'''
